jobs.title: Cloud Engineer Automation
jobs.desc:
Working for a company like Smile Digital Health means supporting our mandate for #BetterGlobalHealth . We strive towards this goal every day, and the results can be seen in the impact of our innovative health data platform and data management solutions, which are used in over 20 countries. We were #19 on Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 Ranking for 2024! Smile Digital Health makes it easy for healthcare stakeholders to collect and exchange data with our leading FHIR-based data liberation platform. At its heart, the Smile platform enables people and organizations to better manage healthcare data. We help generate and liberate structured healthcare data to ensure effective delivery across care teams and health systems bringing #BetterGlobalHealth to patients everyday! Apply today and find plenty of reasons to SMILE! The Cloud Engineer (Automation) is responsible for designing, building, operating and improving production-grade automation for Smile Digital Health, its clients and partners. This role will be responsible for the pipelines, infrastructure as code, environments and recovery procedures, that the platform runs on. This Engineer will merge direct platform engineering expertise with driving strategic changes in how the department designs, deploys, and maintains its infrastructure. Key responsibilities include managing build and release engineering, orchestrating the Terraform and Helm infrastructure, provisioning on-demand environments, and implementing automated recovery. This role works closely with Platform Engineering, Solution Engineering, Service Operations and Engineering Practice QA to remove unnecessary repetitive, manual work and effectively optimize a build from the time the client commits to a running environment faster, decrease platform costs, and utilize AI to enhance the platformâs engineering and operations. 
 Responsibilities: Own build and release engineering by reviewing the current repositories and CI setup, then consolidate duplicated Azure DevOps pipeline YAML onto shared reusable templates with change detection and automated quality gates. Identify and eliminate manual efforts for cross-functional teams and replace them with scheduled, auditable automation. For example, automating patching, certificate and secret rotation, environment scaling, and recurring reports Implement GitOps-based continuous delivery - declarative, Git-driven deployments with automated reconciliation, drift detection and rollback. Automate line-of-business environments end to end, provisioned and torn down on demand across every Azure service and application involved. Automate business continuity and disaster recovery through backup validation, restore and failover, recurring DR drills, and measured RTO and RPO. Ensure Helm and Terraform are easy to upgrade by charting reuse and configuration validation, versioned modules, and state boundaries that limit how far an upgrade reaches. Run in-cluster platform services deployed through Helm, harden workloads for availability and capacity: health probes, replica counts, and right-sized requests, limits and autoscaling. Ensure that the Terraform configuration is regularly maintained. Build and maintain Build Agent images for streamlining tooling available for the builds. Automate the guardrails such as policy-as-code, security and IaC scanning in the pipeline, and alerts and dashboards defined as code. Implement AI-assisted engineering in the platform teamâs day-to-day work Contribute to the departmentâs AI enablement, package knowledge into reusable skills and runbooks in the shared skill library. Work with the development and operations teams to find automation gaps, prioritize them, and close them. Troubleshoot production and staging issues and document what you automate so others can operate it. Requirements: 6+ years of hands-on cloud engineering, DevOps and/or platform engineering experience, including at least 1-2+ years with infrastructure as code and CI/CD automation on Microsoft Azure in production. Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar and/or equivalent work experience. Practical in-depth knowledge and expertise in Terraform, Helm and Azure DevOps pipelines, and GitOps delivery (Argo CD or Flux). Strong Terraform skills including, but not limited to, experience with module design, provider version management, state management and refactoring. Expertise in Helm chart authoring and refactoring, including recent experience with Kubernetes and AKS. Demonstrated knowledge across Azure (AKS, Key Vault, Storage, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, networking, identity) and observability as code (Azure Monitor and/or Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry). Hands-on experience automating backup, restore and failover with measured RTO and RPO. Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools (Claude Code or equivalent), keeping confidential data out of them and reviewing what they produce. Hands-on experience running, hardening and right-sizing production workloads on Kubernetes Hands-on Kafka operations: topic and partition design, consumer group sizing, and throughput and latency trade-offs. Experience migrating between Kafka platforms (HDInsight, Confluent, MSK or self-managed) is a strong asset. Strong Python and Bash skills, able to build maintainable tooling, not glue scripts. A demonstrable record of replacing manual processes with automation. FinOps practice and Azure Cost Management, an asset. Regulated environment experience (healthcare, PHI), an asset. Certifications: HashiCorp Terraform Associate; Microsoft AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-305; CKA or CKAD, an asset. Observability as code with Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry; Azure cost optimization, an asset. 
 $120,000 - $140,000 a year 
 Smile discloses that artificial intelligence (AI) may be used in portions of the recruitment and selection process, such as resume screening or application assessment. All hiring decisions are ultimately made by qualified human decision-makers, and AI tools are used to support â not replace â fair and equitable hiring practices. This position is a new role, created to support Smileâs continued growth and commitment to operational excellence. Some of the benefits we offer: * Remote Work Environment * Flexible Time Away From Work Policy including PTO, Personal and Sick Days * Competitive Salary and Health/Medical Benefits * RRSP/TFSA/401K Employee Contribution * Life and Disability * Employee Assistance Program * FHIR Study Program and Skillsoft Learning * Super HAPI Fun Club Smile's core values include respect, inclusion, embracing our differences, and celebrating shared values because our people are the foundation of our success. We are big on creating a sense of belonging and empowering each other to bring our authentic selves to work. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace that values diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Candidates are encouraged to inform us if they wish to discuss or require accommodations during interviews or while working at Smile. jobs.title: (Senior) Quality Assurance Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.desc: ZEAL Network SE is a dynamic, international group of companies that has been creating exciting and innovative lottery experiences for over 20 years. As Germany’s largest provider of online lotteries through our brands LOTTO24 and Tipp24, and a trusted partner of Spain’s ONCE, the second-largest national lottery, we’re shaping the future of the lottery industry. We are passionate about driving innovation, as demonstrated by our newest brands, Freiheit+ and Traumhausverlosung, which bring fresh and exciting dreams to life. Additionally, through ZEAL Ventures, we invest in inspiring e-commerce start-ups like Omaze and DAYMADE, fueling fresh ideas and opportunities. Our team of 350+ professionals from diverse backgrounds is united by a visionary mindset, a passion for collaboration, and a commitment to inspire dreams. At ZEAL, we empower our people to think ambitiously and work together toward a shared purpose: helping people imagine and achieve their aspirations. As a (Senior) Quality Engineer (f/m/d) in our Backoffice Team, you will help shape a new internal platform used across ZEAL to support business-critical operational workflows. You will join a small cross-functional team and have a high level of ownership from the start. The Backoffice integrates with a wide range of backend services and supports workflows that can have financial, operational and compliance impact. Your work will directly influence how confidently and quickly we can deliver new functionality. This is an engineering-focused quality role. You will work directly in the application codebase alongside the engineers and build the tooling, infrastructure and automated feedback loops that help the team ship safely at high speed. Your tasks: Shape and continuously improve the quality engineering strategy for the Backoffice application Design and build automated test infrastructure across unit, integration, API and end-to-end levels with a strong focus on Playwright and TypeScript Develop reusable test fixtures, test-data seeding, environment tooling, harnesses and abstractions that make realistic and repeatable testing easy. Build fast automated feedback loops and validation mechanisms that make AI-assisted development safer and more effective. Design meaningful regression coverage for critical workflows, complex permissions and scenarios with financial, operational or compliance impact Strengthen CI quality gates and improve test execution so that a green pipeline provides a strong and fast signal that changes are safe to ship. Investigate defects, flaky tests and systemic quality issues and turn findings into durable engineering improvements. Triage bug reports together with internal users, reproduce issues and turn findings into clear actions for the team. Champion a strong quality mindset across the team and challenge workflows and designs from an end-user perspective to identify usability issues and edge cases early. Foster knowledge sharing and collaboration with the wider QA community at ZEAL to exchange practices, tools and learnings. Work closely with engineers, Product, UX and backend teams to identify risks early, improve testability and build quality into the development process What you offer us: Strong software engineering skills and experience in quality engineering, test automation, SDET or a comparable engineering-focused role. Strong hands-on experience with TypeScript or JavaScript and the ability to contribute production-quality code directly to a modern web application. Experience designing and building test frameworks, tooling, harnesses, fixtures and automation infrastructure rather than only writing individual test cases Strong experience with Playwright, Cypress or a similar modern end-to-end testing framework. Good understanding of APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD pipelines and applications that integrate with multiple backend services What we offer: State-of-the-art technologies and an agile environment (Check our Tech Radar: https://lotto24.github.io/tech-radar/ ) A modern, dynamic culture grounded in the success of a leading-edge e-commerce company. A talented team of ambitious, like-minded colleagues where your knowledge and ideas truly make an impact. Ongoing personal growth, supported by an annual development budget of €1,500 to invest in your professional development. Trust and autonomy, no micromanagement, just confidence in your ability to deliver and excel. Flexible work options with a hybrid setup focused on results. Unlimited vacation days in addition to your yearly 30-day vacation allowance. Opportunity for workations abroad using our WorkFlex tool. Monthly mobility allowance of €30 to use on the mobility option of your choice (e.g., the Deutschlandticket), plus access to a company bike leasing program. Company pension scheme, provided in partnership with Degura, to support your future financial security. Subsidized EGYM WELLPASS membership, with a contribution of only €25 per month, giving you access to a wide range of gyms and sports options across Germany. Quarterly company events, along with regular team activities and informal gatherings, a favorite being our Healthy Tuesday lunches or Treat Thursdays in the office! Sounds exciting? Great! We're looking forward to receiving your online application. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Product Intern
jobs.desc: About Inbolt Deploying an industrial robot still takes months of integration and programming, and the moment a part, a process, or a position changes, it starts over. Inbolt makes it take minutes. Our generalist vision model gives robots the ability to see, think, and adapt in real time, so any robot can master any process, part, or station. Set up from a CAD model in minutes and compatible with FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Yaskawa, Comau, and Universal Robots, Inbolt runs in production at Stellantis, Toyota, Ford, GM, Bosch and more, with 200+ systems live across 100+ factories on three continents. We're a team based in Paris, Detroit and Japan, and we're growing fast. Here's the role: As our Associate Product Manager Intern, you will sit at the crossroads of our customers, our sales team and our engineers. Working alongside our Product Lead, you will make sure that what we build answers real business needs: you will gather what customers and the field are telling us, translate it into clear product priorities and specs, and give Sales and Ops the material they need to sell and deploy Inbolt with confidence. In short, your mission is to turn the work of our 20 engineers into value our customers understand and buy. 🎯 Responsibilities Collect and structure customer feedback, feature requests and field issues coming from Sales, Ops and client sites, and turn them into clear, prioritized specs the engineering team can act on. Build a solid understanding of our market: customer use cases, buyer personas in automotive and manufacturing, and how competitors position themselves. Help quantify the business value of new features (time saved, cost avoided, ROI for the customer) to support prioritization and sales arguments. Create sales enablement material with the Sales team: product one-pagers, demo scripts, FAQs and objection handling. Own the product documentation for Inbolt Studio, from the internal knowledge base to release notes and client-facing guides. Organize how each release is shared across the company (release notes, internal demos, training sessions), so that everyone can talk about the product. Take part in product testing before releases and report bugs precisely and reproducibly. ✍️ Position details Team: Product Location: Paris, France Start date: January to March 2027, flexible with your school calendar Contract: 6-month full-time internship, end-of-studies internship (stage de fin d’études) or gap year (césure) Work mode: Hybrid in Paris, with at least one customer site visit during the internship 🔎 Preferred experience Inbolt values end-to-end ownership, high rigor, and a hands-on curiosity. We move fast while staying precise, with a proactive, autonomous, results-driven mindset and strong collaboration with engineering teams. Final-year student in a business school, engineering school or university Master’s program, or on a gap year, available for 6 months. We do not filter on school or track. A strong business sense: you naturally ask who the customer is, what problem they pay to solve and how we win against alternatives. You write clearly about technical topics for people who are not engineers. This is the skill that matters most here, and we test it during the process. You are curious about machines: why this robot stopped, why that part was missed. You work autonomously, and you say “I don’t know, let me find out” instead of guessing. Fluent in English and French. 💫 Additional plus A first experience in a B2B tech, deep tech or industrial environment (product, sales operations, consulting, QA, technical support, application engineering). Experience talking directly with customers or users, through interviews, support or sales. Comfortable with tools like Notion and Linear, and with basic 3D or CAD concepts. You have already built documentation, a market study, a test plan or a process from scratch. ✨ Benefits 📍 Prime office location in Paris 🤝 Team-building events off-sites 🐶 Bring-your-dog-to-work policy 🍽️ Meal: lunch expenses covered 💪 Gymlib: subscription fully covered ✈️ Travel: customer site visit(s) in a real factory Interview process HR call (30 min) with Inès, Talent Partner Case study and technical interview (1h) with Helena, Product Lead, or Jean, Head of Engineering Team interview (30 min) with engineers from the team you will work with every day Founders interview (30 min) with Rudy, CEO Reference checks (if applicable) Why join Inbolt Real impact, on real factory floors: your work runs in production at Stellantis, Toyota, Ford, GM and Bosch, across 100+ factories on three continents. Ownership from day one: we value end-to-end ownership, high rigor and hands-on curiosity, and we move fast while staying precise. An international team: Paris, Detroit and Japan, working closely with world-class robotics and automation partners. A seat at the start of something big: we're building the default intelligence layer for every industrial robot, on every brand. ✨ Benefits 📍 Prime office locations in Paris and Detroit 🤝 Team-building events off-sites 🐶 Bring-your-dog-to-work policy 🍽️ Lunch expenses covered 💪 Gym subscription covered (Gymlib in France) ✈️ Customer site visits in real factories Benefits may vary by location and contract type. 🧭 Our hiring process Introduction call (30 min) with our Talent team, to get to know you and answer your questions.
